title: Region Package Prices
description: Maintain per-state delivery prices by postcode / suburb and their vendor. When a price changes, the previous one is kept in the "Previous price" column.

courierPriceHint: Defaults to price − 0.25; you can override it.
alignRouteCodeHint: Matches inbound scans by postcode + suburb against existing price rows, then looks up each waybill in the central waybill search for its current route code and vendor — more reliable than the vendor field on the scan itself (often not backfilled yet at scan time). Route codes not seen in the window are treated as stale and removed; the vendor is set to whichever one appears most often in the window. Only areas already priced in the current state are aligned — a wider window is more accurate but slower.
